activity.notes: Hamilton's 1832 theory of rays, 1833 work on complex numbers, 1834–1835 papers on dynamics, and 1843 discovery of quaternions were developed in Ireland, then part of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland. The existing umbrella United Kingdom Polity is reused for historical scholarly affiliation, not nationality erasure or political rule.
